title: Tom and Jerry when the animals are real
title_candidates: How AI turned Tom and Jerry into a real movie
Tom and Jerry rebuilt as live action by an AI
What Tom and Jerry actually looks like when AI makes it real
What an AI does when you feed it classic Tom and Jerry footage
The version of Tom and Jerry that only AI could have made
caption:
Someone ran classic Tom and Jerry footage through an AI video model, and it rebuilt every scene as photorealistic live action.

The model keeps the original timing and slapstick beat for beat, but recreates every frame as if it were shot on a real film set. Tom's fur, the shattered plates, the cartoon-speed chases: all of it now exists in a world that looks touchable.

This is what it looks like when AI translates a visual language instead of just copying it.
